name: section-cycle-error-chain
body: Section-template reference cycles are rejected when the library's templates are loaded, and the error names the cycle chain, e.g. `sections/a → sections/b → sections/a`. A reference is a declared `sections:` acceptance or a `section` helper call in a layout (section-helper-load-checks); a cycle closed through helper calls is rejected exactly as a declared one. A cycle is never accepted (the composition walk terminates safely and reports the chain instead of looping), and it is a templates error path-qualified to the offending `template.yaml` (template-build-checks).
